_comment: Epic 7 / Story 7.5 — X-Ray permissions for the test12-lambda-role. Attach to the shared role (e.g. `aws iam put-role-policy --role-name test12-lambda-role --policy-name test12-xray --policy-document file://xray-policy.json`), or attach the AWS managed policy AWSXRayDaemonWriteAccess. Required for the Lambdas (deployed with --tracing-config Mode=Active) to flush trace segments. Same manual-attach convention as sns-ses-policy.json.
